reason: A document with no operation still has "paths": {}. It is valid OAS, but noise: the official document has only webhooks and no paths key.

fizz has no API for webhooks (no option, router method or Generator setter; the README says fizz does not infer them). Only a DocumentHook could write the newPet webhook, which would patch an operation wholesale (D23), so the whole webhooks subtree is a limitation.
